changelog:
The configuration page now explains itself. No behaviour changes — if the plugin is doing what
you want, this release changes nothing for you.

## ✨ Improved

- **An empty language list now says what it does.** The audio list and the subtitle list are
  independent: the audio list only ever picks an audio track, the subtitle list only ever picks
  a subtitle track. A subtitle list left empty means subtitles are never touched, no matter what
  the audio list says — which reads exactly like a plugin that does nothing at all. Each list
  now spells out its own consequence instead of the neutral *"No languages added yet"*, and the
  page asks for both lists to be filled.

- **Series overrides say the opposite thing, because they mean the opposite thing.** An empty
  list on a series override inherits the global list rather than disabling anything, and now
  says so.

- **The subtitle list hint explains why your own language belongs in it.** Listing the language
  you listen in is what lets the plugin turn subtitles off, or fall back to a signs track, when
  the audio already covers you. Nothing on the page said this.

- **A note about Jellyfin's own "Only forced" subtitle mode.** In that mode Jellyfin re-picks
  the subtitle track itself whenever the stream is renegotiated — after a seek, or when a plugin
  such as Intro Skipper jumps ahead — and accepts only a track flagged forced *inside the file*.
  A track named *Forced* or *Signs* without that flag is rejected, so the track this plugin
  chose is dropped mid-episode. Left at its default, Jellyfin restores the selection it
  remembers, which is the one this plugin made. The page now says to leave the mode alone.

## 📖 README

New troubleshooting entries for the three things that actually come up: an empty subtitle list,
a client left open across a plugin update (restart it), and subtitles dropped mid-episode by
*Only forced*. Plus a note that two subtitle tracks sharing a title, a language and no forced
flag are genuinely indistinguishable — that one has to be fixed in the media.

## ⬆️ Upgrading

Straight upgrade from 1.3.1.1 — no configuration changes, and nothing to redo. Server
compatibility is unchanged (**Jellyfin 12.x**); 10.11 servers stay on 1.2.0.1.

## 🔧 Under the hood

- The empty-list message is carried by the list element rather than hard-coded in the renderer,
  which is what lets a global list and a series override disagree about what empty means.
- The root `.gitignore` covered all of `web-tests/`, including the test suite CI runs and the
  package files `npm ci` needs, so touching a test required `git add -f`. The nested
  `web-tests/.gitignore` already drew the right line.
